top.text: The fix isn't a better ticketing tool. It's an AI layer that: — Lives in Teams/Slack/email — Understands natural language — Resolves the 40% that don't need humans — Routes the rest with full context already filled in No portal. No FAQ. No friction.

— 直接嵌入Teams/Slack/邮箱
— 理解自然语言
— 自动解决40%不需要人工的问题  
— 剩下的问题带着完整上下文直接路由给对应人员

不需要门户网站，不需要FAQ，零摩擦。

top.text: Nobody wakes up thinking: "I really need some multi-board task organization today." Your buyer wakes up thinking: "Why does everything feel chaotic and why is nothing getting finished?" Write to that. Not to your feature list.
